name: MAESTRO (MIDI and Audio Edited for Synchronous Tracks and Organization)
description: A dataset of virtuoso piano performances with aligned audio recordings and MIDI files, curated from the International Piano-e-Competition.
citation: Hawthorne, C., Stasyuk, A., Roberts, A., Simon, I., Huang, C.-Z. A., Dieleman, S., Elsen, E., Engel, J., & Eck, D. (2019). Enabling Factorized Piano Music Modeling and Generation with the MAESTRO Dataset. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR). https://openreview.net/forum?id=r1lYRjC9F7
